220: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
221: 		FlagUsageType nonNullFlagUsage = annotationNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE);

225: 		}
226: 		if (nonNullFlagUsage != null) {
227: 			String flaggedMessage = "Use of @NonNull is flagged according to lombok configuration.";
228: 			if (nonNullFlagUsage == FlagUsageType.WARNING) annotationNode.addWarning(flaggedMessage);
229: 			else if (nonNullFlagUsage == FlagUsageType.ERROR) annotationNode.addError(flaggedMessage);
230: 		}
231: 
232: 		JavacNode parentNode = annotationNode.up();
233: 		Kind parentKind = parentNode.getKind();
234: 		if (parentKind == Kind.FIELD) {
235: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
236: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
237: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
238: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
239: 
240: 			JCTree parentTree = parentNode.get();
241: 			JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) parentTree;
242: 			JCExpression fieldType = fieldDecl.vartype;
243: 			try {
244: 				if (isPrimitive(fieldType)) {
245: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
246: 				}
247: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
248: 
249: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = fieldDecl;
250: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
251: 				// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
252: 
253: 				JavacNode recordTypeNode = parentNode.up();
254: 				List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(recordTypeNode, annotationNode);
255: 				for (JCMethodDecl ctr : compactConstructors) {
256: 					addNullCheckIfNeeded(ctr, parentNode, annotationNode);
257: 				}
258: 			}
259: 			return;
260: 		}
261: 
262: 		JCMethodDecl declaration;
263: 		JavacNode paramNode;
264: 
265: 		switch (parentKind) {
266: 		case ARGUMENT:
267: 			paramNode = parentNode;

269: 		case TYPE_USE:

272: 			break;

275: 		}
276: 
277: 		if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
278: 		JavacNode methodNode = paramNode.up();
279: 		try {

281: 		} catch (Exception e) {
282: 			return;
283: 		}
284: 
285: 		if (declaration.body == null) {

287: 			return;
288: 		}
289: 
290: 		if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {

293: 			// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
294: 			return;
295: 		}

299: 		JCVariableDecl parameterDecl = (JCVariableDecl) parameterTree;
300: 		JCExpression parameterType = parameterDecl.vartype;
301: 		if (parameterType != null && isPrimitive(parameterType)) {

303: 			return;
304: 		}

308: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
309: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;
310: 	}
311: 	
312: 	/**
313: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
314: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
315: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
316: 	 */
317: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
318: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
319: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
320: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
321: 		
322: 		if (isExpression) {
323: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
324: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
325: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
326: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
327: 			
328: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
329: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
330: 			Name name = null;
331: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
332: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
333: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
334: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
335: 			}
336: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
337: 			
338: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
339: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
340: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
341: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
342: 		}
343: 		
344: 		if (isIf) {
345: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
346: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
347: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
348: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
349: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
350: 				then = stats.get(0);
351: 			}
352: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
353: 		}
354: 		
355: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
356: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
357: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
358: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
359: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
360: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
361: 			if (isIf) {
362: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
363: 			} else {
364: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
365: 			}
366: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
367: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
368: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
369: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
370: 		}

Done. The fix is in `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleNonNull.java`:

**Root cause**: For a record field with a type-use annotation like `byte @NonNull[] bytes`, the annotation lives inside the field's type tree (`JCAnnotatedType`), not in the field's modifier annotations. The javac `HandleNonNull.handle()` treated a `TYPE_USE` parent only as a method-parameter case and returned early (since the node above wasn't an `ARGUMENT`), so no compact-constructor null check was ever generated for record fields.

**Fix** (src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleNonNull.java:294, new helper at :221): when the annotation's parent chain is a type-use chain ending at a record field, and the annotated `JCAnnotatedType` is the field's entire `vartype` (i.e. the annotation applies to the whole type, not an inner array dimension — mirroring the Eclipse handler's top-level-annotation rule), generate the compact constructor if needed and inject the null check into it.

**Validation**:
- `ant test.javacCurrent`: `NonNullOnRecordTypeUse` (the previously failing case) now passes; the only remaining failures (`BuilderSingularOnRecord`, `FieldNameConstantsOnRecord`, `WithByOnRecordComponent`, `WithOnRecordComponent`) are identical to the unmodified baseline, so no regressions.
- End-to-end with the issue's `NamedByteArray` example: both `new NamedByteArray(null, new byte[0])` and `new NamedByteArray("name", null)` now throw `NullPointerException`, and delombok output shows both null checks in the compact constructor.
